# Living Hinge

Web thickness of living hinges.

<figure markdown="span">
![Living Hinge: on the left what to avoid, on the right what to aim for](../../assets/diagrams/max-living-hinge-web-light.svg#only-light){ width="640" }
![Living Hinge: on the left what to avoid, on the right what to aim for](../../assets/diagrams/max-living-hinge-web-dark.svg#only-dark){ width="640" }
<figcaption>Web thickness of a living hinge; a thick web cracks when it flexes.</figcaption>
</figure>

## Where it applies

| Process | Criticality |
| :-- | :-- |
| [Plastic Injection Molding](../../reference/processes/plastic-injection-molding.md) | Medium |

## Values

**Aim for** is what to design for; crossing it gives a warning. **At most** is the hard limit; crossing it gives an error. See [aim for and limits](../../concepts/aim-for-and-limits.md).

Criticality in this process: **Medium** ([what this means](../../concepts/criticality.md)).

| Material | Aim for | At most | Source |
| :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
| **Default** | 0.4 mm | 0.6 mm | Not yet sourced |

Every other material uses the Default values: PLA, ABS, Acetal / POM, PMMA, LCP, Long-Fiber Reinforced Plastics, PA, PC, PET / PBT, PE, PSU, PP, PS, PUR, PVC.

## Messages

What the results panel says about a finding. You can rewrite these in the Process Library; the words in `{braces}` are filled in for each finding.

!!! warning "Warning"

    Thick Living Hinge (`{measured}`): `{feature}` has a web `{size}`, above the recommended `{target}`. A thicker web is stiffer and strains more each time it flexes. Keep living hinge webs between 0.2 and 0.5 mm.
!!! failure "Error"

    Living Hinge Too Thick (`{measured}`): `{feature}` has a web `{size}`, past `{limit}`. Webs this thick have been reported cracking within a few flexes. Thin the web to `{target}` or less, with radiused shoulders either side.
| Placeholder | Replaced with |
| :-- | :-- |
| `{measured}` | The measured value, with its unit |
| `{target}` | The rule's "Aim for" value |
| `{limit}` | The rule's "At most" value |
| `{feature}` | What it is about, such as "Boss 3 (screw)" or "Face12" |
| `{size}` | Its size or what was found, such as "Ø3.00 mm and 9.00 mm deep" |
